#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Native-unit San Juan house modules and terrain-bound sea-town streets.

Pure build(stock, spec): no runtime writes, launches, downloads or player state.
MODEL geometry labels may repeat a role, sharing one compact GM module per role.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import defaultdict, deque
import hashlib
import math
import struct

from patch_metal_portobello_ground import HEADER, MATERIAL, OBJECT, parse_gm

TOWN = "RESOURCE/MODELS/Locations/Town_PuertoRico/Town/"
ISLAND = "RESOURCE/MODELS/Islands/PuertoRico/"
PATCH = TOWN + "sanjuan_patch_day.ptc"
HOUSES = (3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 19, 22)
PTC_HEADER = struct.Struct("<13i6f")
PTC_TRI = struct.Struct("<4H3h2b")


def _box(points):
    return ([min(v[k] for v in points) for k in range(3)],
            [max(v[k] for v in points) for k in range(3)])


def _header(g, points, objects, triangles, buffers, bsp):
    h = list(g["header"])
    lo, hi = _box(points)
    center = [(a + b) / 2 for a, b in zip(lo, hi)]
    h[1] = 2 if bsp else 0
    h[6:11] = [0, 0, objects, triangles, buffers]
    h[11:18] = [*(b - a for a, b in zip(lo, hi)), *center,
                 max(math.dist(p, center) for p in points)]
    return HEADER.pack(*h) + g["data"][HEADER.size:g["materials_offset"] + h[5] * MATERIAL.size]


def _bsp_source(g):
    data, start = g["data"], g["parsed_end"]
    nn, nv, nt = struct.unpack_from("<3i", data, start)
    ns, vs = start + 12, start + 12 + nn * 24
    ts = vs + nv * 12
    if ts + nt * 9 != len(data) or nt != g["header"][9]:
        raise ValueError("Stock GM collision/render face correspondence changed")
    nodes, order, active = {}, [], set()
    stack = [(0, False)]
    while stack:
        index, done = stack.pop()
        if done:
            order.append(index)
            active.remove(index)
            continue
        if index in nodes or index in active or not 0 <= index < nn:
            raise ValueError("Stock BSP is not a valid tree")
        active.add(index)
        off = ns + index * 24
        bits = struct.unpack_from("<I", data, off + 16)[0]
        child, nf = bits & ((1 << 22) - 1), (bits >> 24) & 15
        faces = tuple(int.from_bytes(data[off + 20 + j * 3:off + 23 + j * 3], "little") for j in range(nf))
        if any(f >= nt for f in faces):
            raise ValueError("Invalid stock BSP face reference")
        left = child if (bits >> 23) & 1 else None
        rd = (bits >> 28) & 3
        right = child + rd if rd else None
        nodes[index] = (data[off:off + 16], bits, faces, left, right)
        stack.append((index, True))
        for sub in (right, left):
            if sub is not None:
                stack.append((sub, False))
    return nodes, order, data[vs:ts], data[ts:]


def _compact_bsp(source, first, count):
    nodes, order, vertex_bytes, face_bytes = source
    retained, trees, used = {}, {}, set()
    for index in order:
        plane, bits, faces, left, right = nodes[index]
        faces = tuple(f for f in faces if first <= f < first + count)
        left, right = retained.get(left), retained.get(right)
        if not faces and (left is None or right is None):
            retained[index] = left if left is not None else right
        elif faces or left is not None or right is not None:
            retained[index] = index
            trees[index] = plane, bits, faces, left, right
            used.update(faces)
        else:
            retained[index] = None
    if used != set(range(first, first + count)):
        raise ValueError("House BSP does not cover every authored render face")
    face_map = {f: f - first for f in sorted(used)}
    vertex_map, raw_vertices, raw_faces = {}, [], []
    for face in range(first, first + count):
        row = []
        for j in range(3):
            old = int.from_bytes(face_bytes[face * 9 + j * 3:face * 9 + j * 3 + 3], "little")
            if old not in vertex_map:
                vertex_map[old] = len(vertex_map)
                raw_vertices.append(vertex_bytes[old * 12:old * 12 + 12])
            row.append(vertex_map[old])
        raw_faces.append(b"".join(v.to_bytes(3, "little") for v in row))
    slots = []

    def reserve(old):
        if old is None:
            return None
        index = len(slots)
        n = len(trees[old][2])
        slots.extend(bytearray(24) for _ in range(1 + max(0, math.ceil((3 * n - 4) / 24))))
        return index

    pending = [(retained[0], reserve(retained[0]))]
    while pending:
        old, index = pending.pop()
        plane, bits, faces, left, right = trees[old]
        li, ri = reserve(left), reserve(right)
        base = li if li is not None else (ri - 1 if ri is not None else 0)
        rd = ri - base if ri is not None else 0
        if not 0 <= rd <= 3 or base >= 1 << 22:
            raise ValueError("Compacted BSP child encoding overflow")
        payload = b"".join(face_map[f].to_bytes(3, "little") for f in faces)
        # Preserve plane-side/type flags; only child pointers/counts change.
        newbits = (bits & ((1 << 22) | (3 << 30))) | base | ((li is not None) << 23) | (len(faces) << 24) | (rd << 28)
        slots[index][:16] = plane
        struct.pack_into("<I", slots[index], 16, newbits)
        for j, value in enumerate(payload):
            if j < 4:
                slots[index][20 + j] = value
            else:
                slots[index + 1 + (j - 4) // 24][(j - 4) % 24] = value
        for child, sub in ((li, left), (ri, right)):
            if sub is not None:
                pending.append((sub, child))
    return (struct.pack("<3i", len(slots), len(raw_vertices), count) + b"".join(slots) +
            b"".join(raw_vertices) + b"".join(raw_faces)), raw_vertices, raw_faces


def _house(g, index, bsp_source):
    obj = list(g["objects"][index])
    buf = g["buffers"][obj[7]]
    raw = g["data"][buf["payload_offset"] + obj[11] * buf["stride"]:
                     buf["payload_offset"] + (obj[11] + obj[10]) * buf["stride"]]
    points = [struct.unpack_from("<3f", raw, j * buf["stride"]) for j in range(obj[10])]
    faces = g["triangles"][obj[9]:obj[9] + obj[8]]
    bsp, cv, cf = _compact_bsp(bsp_source, obj[9], obj[8])
    # Independent oracle: each collision face must exactly match its render face.
    for face, packed in zip(faces, cf):
        collision = [cv[int.from_bytes(packed[j * 3:j * 3 + 3], "little")] for j in range(3)]
        render = [raw[j * buf["stride"]:j * buf["stride"] + 12] for j in face]
        if sorted(collision) != sorted(render):
            raise ValueError(f"House {index} collision/render geometry diverges")
    obj[7], obj[9], obj[11], obj[-1] = 0, 0, 0, obj[8]
    obj[13:21] = [-1] * 8
    result = (_header(g, points, 1, len(faces), 1, True) + OBJECT.pack(*obj) +
              b"".join(struct.pack("<3H", *f) for f in faces) +
              struct.pack("<2i", buf["type"], len(raw)) + raw + bsp)
    lo, hi = _box(points)
    return result, lo, hi, {"source_object": index, "triangles": len(faces),
                            "bytes": len(result), "bsp_nodes": struct.unpack_from("<i", bsp)[0],
                            "bounds": [lo, hi], "exact_collision_faces": len(faces)}


def _mesh(g, obj_index, triangles, with_collision=False):
    import prepare_puerto_rico_city as owner
    obj = list(g["objects"][obj_index])
    buf = g["buffers"][obj[7]]
    stride, typ = buf["stride"], buf["type"]
    fmt = struct.Struct("<6fI" + "f" * ((stride - 28) // 4))
    raw, positions = [], []
    for tri in triangles:
        n, _ = owner.plane(tri)
        for p in tri:
            uv = [p[0] / 4, p[2] / 4] * ((stride - 28) // 8)
            raw.append(fmt.pack(*p[:3], *n, 0xffffffff, *uv))
            positions.append(p[:3])
    if len(raw) >= 65536:
        raise ValueError("Street mesh exceeds native 16-bit draw capacity")
    obj[7:12] = [0, len(triangles), 0, len(raw), 0]
    obj[13:21], obj[-1] = [-1] * 8, len(triangles)
    payload = b"".join(raw)
    return (_header(g, positions, 1, len(triangles), 1, with_collision) + OBJECT.pack(*obj) +
            b"".join(struct.pack("<3H", j, j + 1, j + 2) for j in range(0, len(raw), 3)) +
            struct.pack("<2i", typ, len(payload)) + payload +
            (owner.collision(triangles) if with_collision else b""))


def _matrix(x, y, z, yaw=0, scale=(1, 1, 1)):
    c, s = math.cos(yaw), math.sin(yaw)
    a, b, d = scale
    return (c * a, 0., -s * a, 0., 0., b, 0., 0., s * d, 0., c * d, 0., x, y, z, 1.)


def _ptc(core, triangles, translation, yaw):
    """Merge translated stock PTC with the exact road triangles, rebuild all indices."""
    h = list(PTC_HEADER.unpack_from(core))
    nt, nv, nn = h[6:9]
    old = [PTC_TRI.unpack_from(core, PTC_HEADER.size + j * 16) for j in range(nt)]
    off = PTC_HEADER.size + nt * 16
    angle = math.radians(yaw)
    c, s = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
    tx, ty, tz = translation
    points = []
    for j in range(nv):
        x, y, z = struct.unpack_from("<3f", core, off + j * 12)
        points.append((c * x + s * z + tx, y + ty, -s * x + c * z + tz))
    off += nv * 12
    normals = []
    for j in range(nn):
        x, y, z = struct.unpack_from("<3f", core, off + j * 12)
        normals.append((c * x + s * z, y, -s * x + c * z))
    indices = [list(t[:3]) for t in old]
    normal_ids = [t[3] for t in old]
    material_flags = [t[7:] for t in old]
    vertex_map = {tuple(round(p[k], 5) for k in range(3)): j for j, p in enumerate(points)}
    import prepare_puerto_rico_city as owner
    for tri in triangles:
        face = []
        for p in tri:
            key = tuple(round(v, 5) for v in p[:3])
            if key not in vertex_map:
                vertex_map[key] = len(points)
                points.append(key)
            face.append(vertex_map[key])
        a, b, d = (points[j] for j in face)
        signed = (b[0] - a[0]) * (d[2] - a[2]) - (b[2] - a[2]) * (d[0] - a[0])
        if abs(signed) < 1e-7:
            continue
        if signed > 0:
            face[1], face[2] = face[2], face[1]
        n, _ = owner.plane([points[j] for j in face])
        normal_ids.append(len(normals))
        normals.append(n)
        indices.append(face)
        material_flags.append((0, 0))
    n = len(indices)
    if n >= 32768 or len(points) >= 65536 or len(normals) >= 65536:
        raise ValueError("Sea-town PTC exceeds native signed neighbor/index capacity")
    neighbors = [[-1] * 3 for _ in indices]
    edges = {}
    for j, tri in enumerate(indices):
        for k in range(3):
            edge = tuple(sorted((tri[k], tri[(k + 1) % 3])))
            if edge in edges:
                other, oe = edges.pop(edge)
                neighbors[j][k], neighbors[other][oe] = other, j
            else:
                edges[edge] = (j, k)
    # Core topology is authoritative: retain portals even when stock edge vertices differ.
    for j, tri in enumerate(old):
        neighbors[j] = list(tri[4:7])
    line = (n + 3) // 4
    table = bytearray(b"\xff") * (n * line)
    reverse = [[] for _ in indices]
    for j, row in enumerate(neighbors):
        for edge, dest in enumerate(row):
            if dest >= 0:
                reverse[dest].append((j, edge))
    components, seen = [], set()
    for start in range(n):
        if start in seen:
            continue
        stack, comp = [start], []
        seen.add(start)
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            comp.append(node)
            for nb in neighbors[node]:
                if nb >= 0 and nb not in seen:
                    seen.add(nb)
                    stack.append(nb)
        components.append(comp)
    for dest in range(n):
        visited, queue = {dest}, deque([dest])
        while queue:
            cur = queue.popleft()
            for node, edge in reverse[cur]:
                if node not in visited:
                    visited.add(node)
                    queue.append(node)
                    where, shift = node * line + dest // 4, (dest & 3) * 2
                    table[where] = (table[where] & ~(3 << shift)) | edge << shift
    lo, hi = _box(points)
    lo[0] -= .01
    lo[2] -= .01
    hi[0] += .01
    hi[2] += .01
    width, length = max(1, math.ceil((hi[0] - lo[0]) / 20)), max(1, math.ceil((hi[2] - lo[2]) / 20))
    cells = [[] for _ in range(width * length)]
    for j, tri in enumerate(indices):
        a, b = _box([points[k] for k in tri])
        xs = [max(0, min(width - 1, int((v - lo[0]) / (hi[0] - lo[0]) * width))) for v in (a[0], b[0])]
        zs = [max(0, min(length - 1, int((v - lo[2]) / (hi[2] - lo[2]) * length))) for v in (a[2], b[2])]
        for z in range(zs[0], zs[1] + 1):
            for x in range(xs[0], xs[1] + 1):
                cells[z * width + x].append(j)
    maps, flat = [], []
    for cell in cells:
        maps.append((len(flat), len(cell)))
        flat.extend(cell)
    h[6:13] = [n, len(points), len(normals), length, width, len(flat), line]
    h[13:19] = [*lo, *hi]
    old_end = (PTC_HEADER.size + nt * 16 + nv * 12 + nn * 12 +
               PTC_HEADER.unpack_from(core)[9] * PTC_HEADER.unpack_from(core)[10] * 8 +
               PTC_HEADER.unpack_from(core)[11] * 2 + PTC_HEADER.unpack_from(core)[12] * nt)
    materials = core[old_end:]
    if len(materials) != 260:
        raise ValueError("Expected stock1.01 PTC material table")
    result = (PTC_HEADER.pack(*h) + b"".join(PTC_TRI.pack(*tri, ni, *nb, *mf) for tri, ni, nb, mf in
              zip(indices, normal_ids, neighbors, material_flags)) +
              b"".join(struct.pack("<3f", *p) for p in points) +
              b"".join(struct.pack("<3f", *p) for p in normals) +
              b"".join(struct.pack("<2i", *cell) for cell in maps) +
              struct.pack(f"<{len(flat)}H", *flat) + table + materials)
    return result, {"triangles": n, "vertices": len(points), "bytes": len(result),
                    "components": sorted((len(x) for x in components), reverse=True),
                    "stock_triangles": nt, "street_triangles": n - nt}, (indices, points, neighbors, table, line)


def build(stock: dict[str, bytes], spec: dict) -> dict:
    """Return modules, repeated-role children, ancillary files and JSON metrics."""
    import prepare_puerto_rico_city as owner
    ext = spec.get("extension", {})
    bounds = ext.get("bounds", [700., 250., 1450., 550.])
    step = float(ext.get("block_size", 40.))
    limit = min(150, int(ext.get("max_buildings", 128)))
    relief_limit = float(ext.get("max_foundation_relief", 3.))
    if step < 36 or not 1 <= limit <= 150 or relief_limit > 4:
        raise ValueError("Unsafe city extension parameters")
    town = parse_gm(stock[TOWN + "SanJuan.gm"])
    island = parse_gm(stock[ISLAND + "PuertoRico.gm"])
    source = _bsp_source(town)
    modules, archetypes, module_metrics = {}, {}, {}
    for index in HOUSES:
        role = f"house{index:02d}"
        data, lo, hi, metrics = _house(town, index, source)
        modules[role], archetypes[index], module_metrics[role] = data, (lo, hi), metrics
    del source
    # Sample only primary beach/jungle/rock: never roofs, old town or reef.
    ground, spatial = [], defaultdict(list)
    allowed = {"beach.tga", "jungle_gray.tga", "rockk1.tga", "rockk2.tga"}
    for obj in island["objects"]:
        texture = island["textures"][island["materials"][obj[12]][10]].lower()
        if texture not in allowed:
            continue
        for full in owner.vertices(island, obj):
            tri = tuple(tuple(v[:3]) for v in full)
            lo, hi = _box(tri)
            if hi[0] < bounds[0] - 5 or lo[0] > bounds[2] + 5 or hi[2] < bounds[1] - 5 or lo[2] > bounds[3] + 5:
                continue
            a, b, c = tri
            det = (b[2] - c[2]) * (a[0] - c[0]) + (c[0] - b[0]) * (a[2] - c[2])
            if abs(det) < 1e-8:
                continue
            j = len(ground)
            ground.append((tri, det))
            for x in range(math.floor(lo[0] / 20), math.floor(hi[0] / 20) + 1):
                for z in range(math.floor(lo[2] / 20), math.floor(hi[2] / 20) + 1):
                    spatial[x, z].append(j)

    def height(x, z):
        found = []
        for j in spatial[math.floor(x / 20), math.floor(z / 20)]:
            (a, b, c), det = ground[j]
            u = ((b[2] - c[2]) * (x - c[0]) + (c[0] - b[0]) * (z - c[2])) / det
            v = ((c[2] - a[2]) * (x - c[0]) + (a[0] - c[0]) * (z - c[2])) / det
            if min(u, v, 1 - u - v) >= -1e-6:
                found.append(u * a[1] + v * b[1] + (1 - u - v) * c[1])
        return max(found) if found else None

    children, lots, blocks, rejected = [], [], [], defaultdict(int)
    x0, z0, x1, z1 = bounds
    cols, rows = int((x1 - x0 - 8) // step), int((z1 - z0 - 8) // step)
    # Waterfront rows first; fit actual terrain instead of scaling the town.
    for row in reversed(range(rows)):
        for col in range(cols):
            bx, bz = x0 + 4 + col * step, z0 + 4 + row * step
            corners = [(bx, bz), (bx + step, bz), (bx + step, bz + step), (bx, bz + step)]
            perimeter = []
            valid = True
            for a, b in zip(corners, corners[1:] + corners[:1]):
                segment = []
                for k in range(5):
                    x, z = a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * k / 4, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * k / 4
                    h = height(x, z)
                    if h is None or h < 1:
                        valid = False
                        break
                    segment.append((x, h + .06, z))
                if not valid or any(abs(a[1] - b[1]) / math.dist((a[0], a[2]), (b[0], b[2])) > .45 for a, b in zip(segment, segment[1:])):
                    valid = False
                    break
                perimeter.extend(segment[:-1])
            if not valid:
                rejected["steep_or_missing_road"] += 1
                continue
            admitted = []
            for cell, (dx, dz) in enumerate(((.25, .25), (.75, .25), (.25, .75), (.75, .75))):
                index = HOUSES[(row * cols * 4 + col * 4 + cell) % len(HOUSES)]
                lo, hi = archetypes[index]
                yaw = ((row + col + cell) % 4) * math.pi / 2
                c, s = round(math.cos(yaw)), round(math.sin(yaw))
                sx, sz = (hi[0] - lo[0]) / 2, (hi[2] - lo[2]) / 2
                wx, wz = abs(c) * sx + abs(s) * sz, abs(s) * sx + abs(c) * sz
                if max(wx, wz) + .6 > step / 4 - 2.5:
                    rejected["lot_fit"] += 1
                    continue
                cx, cz = bx + dx * step + ((row + cell) % 3 - 1) * .35, bz + dz * step + ((col + cell) % 3 - 1) * .35
                footprint = [(cx + ax * wx, cz + az * wz) for ax in (-1, 0, 1) for az in (-1, 0, 1)]
                heights = [height(x, z) for x, z in footprint]
                if any(y is None or y < 1 for y in heights) or max(heights) - min(heights) > relief_limit:
                    rejected["foundation_relief"] += 1
                    continue
                base = max(heights) + .06
                ox, oz = (lo[0] + hi[0]) / 2, (lo[2] + hi[2]) / 2
                placement = _matrix(cx - c * ox - s * oz, base - lo[1], cz + s * ox - c * oz, yaw)
                admitted.append((f"house{index:02d}", placement, (cx - wx - .15, cz - wz - .15, cx + wx + .15, cz + wz + .15), base, min(heights) - .15))
            if not admitted:
                continue
            admitted = admitted[:max(0, limit - len(lots))]
            if not admitted:
                continue
            blocks.append((bx, bz, perimeter))
            for role, placement, footprint, top, bottom in admitted:
                children.append((role, placement))
                a, b, d, e = footprint
                children.append(("foundation", _matrix((a + d) / 2, bottom, (b + e) / 2, scale=(d - a, top - bottom, e - b))))
                lots.append({"role": role, "footprint": list(footprint), "base": top, "relief": top - bottom, "matrix": list(placement)})
    if not lots:
        raise ValueError("No native-size houses fit the protected terrain")
    # Tile non-overlapping junction squares and connecting strips, clipped against
    # the original ground triangles. Every street/nav face has the same substrate.
    junctions, edges = set(), set()
    for bx, bz, _ in blocks:
        points = [(bx, bz), (bx + step, bz), (bx + step, bz + step), (bx, bz + step)]
        junctions.update(points)
        edges.update(tuple(sorted((a, b))) for a, b in zip(points, points[1:] + points[:1]))
    rectangles = [(x - 2, z - 2, x + 2, z + 2) for x, z in sorted(junctions)]
    for a, b in sorted(edges):
        if a[0] == b[0]:
            for j in range(3):
                lo, hi = a[1] + 2 + j * (step - 4) / 3, a[1] + 2 + (j + 1) * (step - 4) / 3
                rectangles.append((a[0] - 2, lo, a[0] + 2, hi))
        else:
            for j in range(3):
                lo, hi = a[0] + 2 + j * (step - 4) / 3, a[0] + 2 + (j + 1) * (step - 4) / 3
                rectangles.append((lo, a[1] - 2, hi, a[1] + 2))
    roads = []
    for a, b, c, d in rectangles:
        candidates = set()
        for x in range(math.floor(a / 20), math.floor(c / 20) + 1):
            for z in range(math.floor(b / 20), math.floor(d / 20) + 1):
                candidates.update(spatial[x, z])
        for j in sorted(candidates):
            poly = list(ground[j][0])
            for axis, edge, positive in ((0, a, True), (0, c, False), (2, b, True), (2, d, False)):
                poly = owner.clip(poly, axis, edge, positive)
            for k in range(1, len(poly) - 1):
                tri = (poly[0], poly[k], poly[k + 1])
                if owner.area(tri) > 1e-6:
                    cx, cz = sum(v[0] for v in tri) / 3, sum(v[2] for v in tri) / 3
                    if abs(sum(v[1] for v in tri) / 3 - height(cx, cz)) > .05:
                        continue
                    roads.append(tuple((v[0], v[1] + .06, v[2]) for v in tri))
    # A small closed cube is the shared rendered/collision foundation module.
    cube = [(-.5, 0, -.5), (.5, 0, -.5), (.5, 0, .5), (-.5, 0, .5),
            (-.5, 1, -.5), (.5, 1, -.5), (.5, 1, .5), (-.5, 1, .5)]
    box_faces = [(0, 2, 1), (0, 3, 2), (4, 5, 6), (4, 6, 7), (0, 1, 5), (0, 5, 4),
                 (1, 2, 6), (1, 6, 5), (2, 3, 7), (2, 7, 6), (3, 0, 4), (3, 4, 7)]
    modules["foundation"] = _mesh(town, 26, [tuple(cube[i] for i in reversed(face)) for face in box_faces], True)
    modules["streets"] = _mesh(town, 26, roads)
    children.append(("streets", _matrix(0, 0, 0)))
    ptc, nav_metrics, nav = _ptc(stock[PATCH], roads, spec.get("translation", [1100, 0, 650]), spec.get("yaw_degrees", 0))
    routes = [points for _, _, points in blocks][:60]
    indices, points, neighbors, table, line = nav
    # Keep some residents inside the actual port core as well as its extensions.
    core_count = nav_metrics["stock_triangles"]
    centers = [tuple(sum(points[v][k] for v in tri) / 3 for k in range(3)) for tri in indices[:core_count]]
    for start in (0, core_count // 4, core_count // 2, 3 * core_count // 4):
        path, seen = [start], {start}
        for _ in range(7):
            eligible = [nb for nb in neighbors[path[-1]] if 0 <= nb < core_count and nb not in seen
                        and math.dist(centers[path[-1]], centers[nb]) < 18]
            if not eligible:
                break
            path.append(eligible[0])
            seen.add(eligible[0])
        if len(path) > 1:
            route = [centers[j] for j in path]
            routes.append(route + route[-2:0:-1])

    def find_node(point):
        x, y, z = point
        for j, face in enumerate(indices):
            tri = [points[k] for k in face]
            if all((-(b[2] - a[2])) * (x - a[0]) + (b[0] - a[0]) * (z - a[2]) <= 1e-4 for a, b in zip(tri, tri[1:] + tri[:1])):
                return j
        return -1

    route_nodes = []
    for route in routes:
        nodes = [find_node(p) for p in route]
        if min(nodes) < 0:
            raise ValueError("Street route point falls outside its PTC")
        for start, dest in zip(nodes, nodes[1:] + nodes[:1]):
            cur, seen = start, set()
            while cur != dest:
                if cur in seen:
                    raise ValueError("PTC route lookup contains a loop")
                seen.add(cur)
                edge = (table[cur * line + dest // 4] >> ((dest & 3) * 2)) & 3
                if edge == 3 or neighbors[cur][edge] < 0:
                    raise ValueError("Street route crosses disconnected PTC components")
                cur = neighbors[cur][edge]
        route_nodes.append(nodes)
    for i, a in enumerate(lots):
        ax, az, bx, bz = a["footprint"]
        for b in lots[i + 1:]:
            cx, cz, dx, dz = b["footprint"]
            if min(bx, dx) > max(ax, cx) and min(bz, dz) > max(az, cz):
                raise ValueError("House foundation footprints overlap")
    config = ["[town]", "patch=RESOURCE\\MODELS\\Islands\\PuertoRico\\sea_town.ptc", "actors=32",
              f"routes={len(routes)}", "activation_distance=1800", "animation=man", "", "[models]",
              "model=citiz_6", "model=pirate_7"]
    for j, route in enumerate(routes):
        config.extend(["", f"[route{j}]"] + ["point=" + ",".join(f"{v:.5f}" for v in p) for p in route])
    building_points = [(v, 0, z) for lot in lots for v, z in ((lot["footprint"][0], lot["footprint"][1]), (lot["footprint"][2], lot["footprint"][3]))]
    lo, hi = _box(building_points)
    metrics = {"buildings": len(lots), "blocks": len(blocks), "bounds": [lo[0], lo[2], hi[0], hi[2]],
               "modules": module_metrics, "module_bytes": sum(map(len, modules.values())),
               "street_triangles": len(roads), "street_rectangles": len(rectangles), "navigation": nav_metrics,
               "routes": len(routes), "route_points": sum(map(len, routes)), "route_nodes": route_nodes,
               "max_route_spacing": max(math.dist(a, b) for r in routes for a, b in zip(r, r[1:] + r[:1])),
               "max_foundation_height": max(lot["relief"] for lot in lots), "lots": lots,
               "rejected": dict(rejected), "native_house_scale": 1.0,
               "core_ptc_sha256": hashlib.sha256(stock[PATCH]).hexdigest(),
               "fort_clearance_xz": min(math.hypot(max(1472 - lot["footprint"][2], lot["footprint"][0] - 1661, 0), max(1241 - lot["footprint"][3], lot["footprint"][1] - 1431, 0)) for lot in lots)}
    return {"modules": modules, "children": children,
            "files": {ISLAND + "sea_town.ptc": ptc, "RESOURCE/INI/sea_towns/puerto_rico.ini": ("\n".join(config) + "\n").encode("ascii")},
            "metrics": metrics}
